verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Logseq supports block and page properties through `key:: value` syntax (e.g. `publish:: true`). It also has tags such as `#Page` in the DB version and simple queries via `{{query}}` and `/query` for retrieval, so the core of tagging plus property-based organization is present. Nothing documents typed property schemas, and a long-time DB-version user calls some organizational concepts half-baked. Missing for 10: documented typed or schema-enforced properties, evidence of querying by property or tag values, independent hands-on corroboration of consistent property and tag workflows.
